question: Should experimental Claw lifecycle diagnostics become a core `openclaw doctor` contribution, or should the lifecycle-support surface remain outside core until the Claws product direction is accepted?
rationale: The patch is broadly coherent and has real behavior proof, but choosing a permanent core Doctor/support contract is a product-boundary decision rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Sponsor the gated core diagnostic
options.body: Keep the feature experimental in core, correct the docs to state the gate, and review/land it after its MCP ownership prerequisite.

options.title: Defer the core Doctor surface
options.body: Keep this PR open only if maintainers want to settle the broader Claws lifecycle direction before accepting a new core diagnostic contract.

options.title: Move diagnostics outside core
options.body: Ask for a plugin-owned or external diagnostic path if maintainers do not want core Doctor to own experimental Claw lifecycle support.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated core diagnostic
recommendation.body: Keep the feature experimental in core, correct the docs to state the gate, and review/land it after its MCP ownership prerequisite.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comments define the concrete operational and support expectations this diagnostic must satisfy; final product sponsorship may require broader maintainer agreement.
